answers.rationale: auto_commit flushes and truncates the WAL after each statement when no explicit transaction is active, giving per-statement implicit commit semantics.

answers.rationale: The WAL is append-only; on startup TxnManager::recover reads and replays committed records, then truncates the log.

answers.rationale: Each WAL record carries a CRC32 of its payload; read_all stops replay at the first record with a CRC mismatch.

answers.rationale: README describes a Volcano-style iterator model with open/next/close; the PhysicalPlan enum defines discrete operator nodes (SeqScan, Filter, Project, etc.) for this tree.

answers.rationale: The codebase writes per-statement summaries to stderr via eprintln! and data to stdout via print!, so writing summaries to stdout would break the separation contract.

answers.rationale: PAGE_SIZE is a single compile-time constant (4096) with no variable sizing per table; mixed 4K/16K pages are inconsistent with this fixed constant.

presented_options.A: an error at startup demanding manual recovery before any SELECT can run
presented_options.B: all three rows — every fsynced WAL record is replayed on startup

answers.rationale: Recovery builds a committed_xids set from Commit records; a transaction with no Commit record is treated as uncommitted and its writes are discarded.
